description: Deliver a message to a registered peer agent. When important=true the platform prepends 'IMPORTANT: ' to the content, which queues a live turn-triggering event on the recipient's bridge: Claude Code uses the registered native wake adapter; locally patched Codex uses notifications/homunculus/peer_message through its MCP notification sink; other clients must surface the notification or catch up with peer_inbox(include_important=true). Use this as a scheduled action inside execute_in_seconds or create_cron_schedule to implement durable wake-up notifications: the scheduler fires an arbitrary action whose definition is this process, delivering the message via the existing peer_send IMPORTANT path.
embedding_description: Send a text message to a registered peer agent by peer_id. Setting important=true prepends IMPORTANT: and queues a live turn-triggering event through the receiver's supported wake path. Primary use case: scheduled wake-up action so a session can notify itself or another peer at a future time.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Thread id, message id, delivery channel (persisted_silent/queued_notification/queued_wake), and resolved recipient identifiers. A queued_* channel means the event was placed on the recipient's live bridge queue, not that a turn started — REL-06 honest naming.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm successful delivery to the named peer; surface the delivery channel so the caller can distinguish a queued live event (queued_notification / queued_wake) from a silent persistence (persisted_silent).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Delivers a peer message via the agent_messaging bridge. send_peer_message accepts {peer_id, peer_agent_instance_id?, content, important?}.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: bridge.not_running: start_interface has not been called yet. peer_send_failed: the peer is not reachable (peer_unreachable), the recipient bridge is gone (bridge_not_found), or the event queue is full (bridge_queue_full). peer_ambiguous: multiple instances of peer_id are registered and no peer_agent_instance_id was given.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For bridge.not_running: ensure start_interface has completed before scheduling peer messages. For peer_unreachable: verify the target peer is registered via peer_list before scheduling. For peer_ambiguous: supply peer_agent_instance_id to disambiguate. For bridge_queue_full: retry with a shorter message or after a delay.
